title: Natalie Bria Hodges
text:
I am a first-year Ph.D. student in the Department of Political Science at Florida State University. I study international relations, with a focus on international political economy. I am interested in global online markets and international economic institutions.
Before starting my Ph.D. at FSU, I earned a B.A. in International Relations from Brigham Young University in 2024.
